known_boundaries: Business operation counts exclude automatic page assets, token-provider requests and other background network activity.
Initial wrong-layer business-status decoding and one same-path capture attribution problem remain recorded; corrected runs supply positive assertions.
PC page_pc requires kz in this run; the initial tid attempt was not a valid positive request.
PC user-card portrait includes a query suffix; base portrait keys match the controlled users, without equating PC tieba_uid to native App UID.
The reviewed frontend MsgGuideDialog guides users to the App for private messaging; PC send/receive has not been established.
Generic 210009 and 300000 errors remain unresolved rather than being called account or Android-device restrictions.
Literal URL patterns in four bundles do not enumerate every possible PC runtime API.
